tools.name: find_member
tools.description: Look up a member or staff person by name, phone or ID.

tools.name: get_class_schedule
tools.description: List classes on a given date with class IDs, times, instructors and open spots.

tools.description: List a member's upcoming class bookings.

tools.description: Fetch a member's invoice and its line items for a month.

tools.description: Change one field on a member's record.
